items.source: Determines the list of MediaType for the given HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 确定给定 `HttpServletRequest` 的MediaType列表。`MediaType`

items.source: Return the ContentNegotiationManager to use to determine requested media types.
items.translation: 返回ContentNegotiationManager用于确定请求的媒体类型。

items.source: The ContentNegotiatingViewResolver does not resolve views itself, but delegates to other ViewResolvers. By default, these other view resolvers are picked up automatically from the application context, though they can also be set explicitly by using the viewResolvers property. Note that in order for this view resolver to work properly, the order property needs to be set to a higher precedence than the others (the default is Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE).
items.translation: ContentNegotiatingViewResolver 本身不解析视图，而是委托给其他 ViewResolvers。默认情况下，这些其他视图解析器会自动从应用程序上下文中获取，但也可以通过使用 viewResolvers 属性显式设置。注意，为了使该视图解析器正常工作，order 属性需要设置为比其他解析器更高的优先级（默认为 Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE）。

items.source: This view resolver uses the requested media type to select a suitable View for a request. The requested media type is determined through the configured ContentNegotiationManager. Once the requested media type has been determined, this resolver queries each delegate view resolver for a View and determines if the requested media type is compatible with the view's content type). The most compatible view is returned.
items.translation: 此视图解析器使用请求的媒体类型来选择一个合适的View以响应请求。请求的媒体类型是通过配置的ContentNegotiationManager确定的。一旦确定了请求的媒体类型，此解析器就会查询每个委托视图解析器以获取一个View，并确定请求的媒体类型是否与视图的内容类型兼容）。返回最兼容的视图。

items.source: Default is false, meaning that this view resolver returns null for resolveViewName(String, Locale) when an acceptable view cannot be found. This will allow for view resolvers chaining. When this property is set to true, resolveViewName(String, Locale) will respond with a view that sets the response status to 406 Not Acceptable instead.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，这意味着当找不到可接受的视图时，该视图解析器会对resolveViewName(String, Locale)返回 `null`。这将允许视图解析器进行链式调用。当将此属性设置为 `true` 时，resolveViewName(String, Locale)将响应一个将响应状态设置为 `406 Not Acceptable` 的视图。

items.source: For example, if the request path is /view.html, this view resolver will look for a view that has the text/html content type (based on the html file extension). A request for /view with a text/html request Accept header has the same result.
items.translation: 例如，如果请求路径是 `/view.html`，此视图解析器将查找具有 `text/html` 内容类型的视图（基于 `html` 文件扩展名）。对于带有 `text/html` 请求 `Accept` 头的 `/view` 请求，结果相同。

items.source: The default implementation is empty. Called by WebApplicationObjectSupport.initApplicationContext(org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext) as well as WebApplicationObjectSupport.setServletContext(jakarta.servlet.ServletContext).
items.translation: 默认实现为空。由WebApplicationObjectSupport.initApplicationContext(org.springframework.context.ApplicationContext)以及WebApplicationObjectSupport.setServletContext(jakarta.servlet.ServletContext)调用。

items.source: Additionally, this view resolver exposes the defaultViews property, allowing you to override the views provided by the view resolvers. Note that these default views are offered as candidates, and still need have the content type requested (via file extension, parameter, or Accept header, described above).
items.translation: 此外，此视图解析器还公开了defaultViews属性，允许您覆盖视图解析器提供的视图。请注意，这些默认视图是作为候选项提供的，并且仍然需要满足请求的内容类型（通过文件扩展名、参数或上文描述的Accept头）。

items.source: If not set, ContentNegotiationManager's default constructor will be used, applying a HeaderContentNegotiationStrategy.
items.translation: 如果未设置，将使用 ContentNegotiationManager 的默认构造函数，应用一个HeaderContentNegotiationStrategy。

items.source: If this property is not set, view resolvers will be detected automatically.
items.translation: 如果未设置此属性，视图解析器将自动检测。

items.translation: 设置默认视图，当无法从 `ViewResolver` 链中获取更具体的视图时使用。

items.source: Note: To allow for ViewResolver chaining, a ViewResolver should return null if a view with the given name is not defined in it. However, this is not required: Some ViewResolvers will always attempt to build View objects with the given name, unable to return null (rather throwing an exception when View creation failed).
items.translation: 注意：为了支持 ViewResolver 链式调用，如果未定义具有给定名称的视图，ViewResolver 应返回 `null`。然而，这并非必需：某些 ViewResolver 将始终尝试使用给定名称构建 View 对象，无法返回 `null`（而是在视图创建失败时抛出异常）。

items.source: Higher values are interpreted as lower priority. As a consequence, the object with the lowest value has the highest priority (somewhat analogous to Servlet load-on-startup values).
items.translation: 较高的值被解释为较低的优先级。因此，具有最低值的对象具有最高的优先级（类似于 Servlet 的 `load-on-startup` 值）。

items.source:
Same order values will result in arbitrary sort positions for the
affected objects.
items.translation: 相同的顺序值将导致受影响的对象具有任意的排序位置。
